column1: What's cookin', good lookin'? asks your old friend, Sweet Cheeks Marie. "It's been too long, Sonny. I haven't seen ya around lately; I just know you want something!"

column1: You know what I heard the other day? says Marie, "there's a big dope man tryin' to take over Lytton. He likes to call himself 'The Death Angel!' I don't know no more about him, but this john was sure a peculiar duck."
column2: Marie 說：「你知道我前幾天聽到什麼嗎？有個大毒梟想接管 Lytton。他喜歡自稱『死亡天使』！我不知道更多，但這個嫖客真是個怪人。」

column1: I only seen him once, and I'm not sure about his name. I think it was Coffman, or Hoffman, or something like that. He's a real spiffy dresser, but the funniest thing: the guy has a sweet, little, flower tattoo above his left nipple. It was kinda cute, really.
column2: 「我只見過他一次，也不確定名字。我想是 Coffman、Hoffman，或類似的名字。他穿得非常時髦，但最有趣的是：那傢伙左邊乳頭上方有朵可愛的小花刺青。真的有點可愛。」
